Base directory for this skill: D:\Apps\micro1-frontier-hackathon\runtime\.claude\skills\aliasbreaker

Run one AliasBreaker campaign following the protocol in CLAUDE.md exactly.

- CASE = the fixture path given in the arguments (e.g.
  `../data/cases/dev/case-101.json`).
- RUN = `runs/<run-id>` if a run id was given, else `runs/<case-id>-manual`.

Begin with `start`, follow the decision guidance, and end with `finalize`.
All hard rules in CLAUDE.md apply unchanged.


ARGUMENTS: ../data/cases/dev/case-102.json runs/dev-v1b-case-102-r1

input.command: cd "D:\Apps\micro1-frontier-hackathon\runtime" && python -m aliasbreaker.cli observe --run runs/dev-v1b-case-102-r1 --slot 2 --why "Slot targets peak 4-sigma separation between leading candidates 1 and 2, the dominant surviving pair, while preserving later slots for confirmation"

cd "D:\Apps\micro1-frontier-hackathon\runtime" && python -m aliasbreaker.cli observe --run runs/dev-v1b-case-102-r1 --slot 4 --why "Confirmation observation at 4-sigma separation to resolve remaining support for candidate 2 against leading candidate 1 before finalizing"

cd "D:\Apps\micro1-frontier-hackathon\runtime" && python -m aliasbreaker.cli observe --run runs/dev-v1b-case-102-r1 --slot 5 --why "Slot 5 gives 4-sigma separation for both live pairs 0-1 and 0-2 simultaneously, maximizing information after the unexpected support reversal toward candidate 2"

content.text: Only pair 1-2 remains live, at 4σ separation. Observe the top slot.

input.command: cd "D:\Apps\micro1-frontier-hackathon\runtime" && python -m aliasbreaker.cli observe --run runs/dev-v1b-case-102-r1 --slot 8 --why "Only pair 1 and 2 remain live and slot 8 gives peak 4-sigma separation to try to push candidate 2 support past the resolution threshold"

content.text: Candidate 2 at 0.981, still below theta=0.997. One more confirmation at the top-separation slot.

input.command: cd "D:\Apps\micro1-frontier-hackathon\runtime" && python -m aliasbreaker.cli observe --run runs/dev-v1b-case-102-r1 --slot 21 --why "Candidate 2 support at 0.98 is just under the 0.997 resolution threshold so one more 4-sigma observation on the sole remaining live pair is spent to try to cross it"

content.text: Candidate 2 support = 0.99999, above theta (0.997). Resolved. Finalize now with 1 observation still in reserve.

input.command: cd "D:\Apps\micro1-frontier-hackathon\runtime" && python -m aliasbreaker.cli finalize --run runs/dev-v1b-case-102-r1 --why "Candidate 2 at period 11.35 days reached support 0.99999, clearing the 0.997 resolution threshold after a confirmation observation, so the campaign resolves in its favor with one observation left in reserve"

content.text:
Campaign complete and resolved.

**Result:** Candidate 2 (period ≈ 11.3505 days) selected with support 0.99999, clearing θ=0.997. Used 5 of 6 observations, 1 held in reserve.

**Path:** The initial fit favored candidate 1 (support 0.564); after the first follow-up (slot 2, 4σ separation) support jumped to 0.823 for candidate 1 but a confirmation point (slot 4) reversed the picture, boosting candidate 2 to 0.746 — a genuine noisy-alias flip that justified the extra confirmation-observation guidance. Two more high-separation observations (slots 5, 8) eliminated candidates 0 and drove candidate 2 to 0.981, and a final confirmation (slot 21) pushed it past the threshold to 0.99999. Finalized once resolution was clean.
